rationale: The product's primary output is a ranked shortlist of duplicate candidates for a developer. On the validation split, hybrid had the best MRR@3 (0.9177814939) and Recall@3 (1.0) among the four evaluated methods. Semantic had the best pairwise F1 (0.7637006482), but the selection criterion for this phase is top-three candidate ranking.
threshold_selection: F1-maximising threshold selected using training labels only; frozen before held-out test evaluation.
score_calibration: Each component is transformed using a logistic mapping of a z-score. Means and standard deviations are calculated from training scores only and reused for test scores.
human_review_status: The Phase 5 audit was AI-assisted. No independent human adjudications have been entered; AI notes are not used as benchmark labels or for threshold tuning.
guardrails: Do not change the threshold after viewing test results.
Do not alter weights, model, preprocessing, ranking rule, or candidate eligibility after viewing test results.
Report weak-negative metrics as agreement with weak labels, not confirmed false-positive rates.
Keep the baseline comparison on the same held-out test pairs.
